unavailable_lanes: Independently initialized C84/C85/Jim core/public SDK availability only. No optional TclOO package absence claim.

scenarios.0: Missing original source; later unused destination original String can distinguish stock-worker stop from public Eval error-context reads
scenarios.1: Same table record via two distinct same-byte original headers; preserve source declaration
scenarios.2: Occupied different destination record; preserve both declarations
scenarios.3: Vacant destination; payload-preserving rename and original name-object reference
scenarios.4: Vacant uppercase destination; preserve original public flag instead of reclassifying from destination spelling
scenarios.5: Counted embedded-NUL original source and vacant destination
scenarios.7: Literal root-qualified-looking method names; method object-hash geometry independent of command namespace lookup

object_scope.0: Class instance-method table through original oo::define context
object_scope.1: Per-object method table through original oo::objdefine context

entry_channel.0: Actual public Tcl_EvalObjv on original renamemethod argv, inside genuine public definition context; public error-context getters remain part of this channel
entry_channel.1: Actual object command worker obtained by public Tcl_GetCommandInfo, called through selected objProc or objProc2 with its authentic clientData and Count ABI inside the genuine public definition context. This channel is not public Eval equivalence.

original_roles.from/to: Distinct caller-held native+1 original custom objects, absent String until actual updateStringProc; counted complete payload incl NUL is never serialized into a script
original_roles.method clientData tokens: Two independent caller-held native+1 custom objects. Installed custom MethodType clientData adds native+1 and actual deleteProc releases it; State persists through interpreter and caller-header cleanup. No token String getter in raw records.
original_roles.declared method-name: Separate actual public method install name objects. Successful native rename may adopt the destination original object as the method name; raw original header refs record that distinct role.
original_roles.method addresses: Opaque public method addresses are diagnostic only, not stable generation/identity proof

record_channels.ROW: Raw original header refs/String residency/updater/free/duplicate and real method calls/delete counters; no presentation getter
record_channels.EVENT: Actual reached callbacks with explicit phase and sequence
record_channels.API: Public CmdInfo selected worker/actual native-object kind/Count width; records unsupported obtained ABI instead of defaulting
record_channels.RESULT/ERRORCODE: Explicit result and actual return-option error code presentation, phase-separated from raw worker return
record_channels.CASE/METHOD: Original scenario/scope/channel maps and actual install success; addresses diagnostic only

purpose_limits: No outcomes inferred before Root captures all exact processes.
Public EvalObjv error-context argv getters are not attributed to stock rename lookup. The explicit CmdInfo channel has its own source/API purpose.
No Method record generation, name relookup authority, physical receiver/edit/program admission or blanket clientData lifetime rule from header payload equivalence.
Only the finite held-original successful and refusal cases; no optional extension or C84/C85/Jim TclOO claim.
required_receipts: Original fixed source/header/config/static library/CLI/link closure/executable pins before and after each reached process
Separate actual provider worker/version/build/count metadata; no cached or nominal profile substitution
